product_launches.description: Waddle launched its AI growth agent Gentoo AI on the U.S. Shopify App Store in September, positioning it as an AI shopping mall operator for real-time conversion optimization.

overview_description.description: Meet Gentoo: an AI Concierge that turns hesitation into conversion—like an in-store sales assistant. Unlike in offline stores, online shoppers are left struggling with search bars and filters—with no one to step in when they hesitate. Gentoo is an AI Concierge that transforms these moments of hesitation into conversion by delivering guided experiences on your storefront. Trained on your product catalog, Gentoo recognizes hesitation and initiates a conversation—just like an in-store assistant—to truly understand needs and guide users to products that genuinely fit.
